pattern: Segmented time field in a labelled group (as Date Input) with a button that opens a WAI-ARIA APG listbox popup: focus moves into the single-select listbox, which conveys the active option through aria-activedescendant.

aria.value: Help text and visible error message ids
Localized segment name (Hour, Minute, Second, AM/PM)
"true" only while an error message is shown
true when the listbox is shown
id of the active option while open; removed when closed
"true" for the option equal to the value, "false" otherwise

keyboard.action: Enters digits; advances when the segment is full or no further digit could be valid (for example 7 in the hour of a 24-hour clock).

keyboard.key: A / P (or the localized day period)
keyboard.action: Sets AM or PM and advances.
Pads a single digit and advances to the next segment.
Increments or decrements with wrap (hours 1-12 or 0-23, minutes and seconds 0-59); toggles AM/PM. Empty segments start at the minimum (Up) or maximum (Down).
Previous or next segment, following the visual order of the LTR-isolated segment run.
Opens the listbox (or closes it when open) and moves focus into it.
Moves the active option without wrapping.
Typeahead: activates the next option whose label starts with the typed text; Space continues a query in progress.
Selects the active option, closes, returns focus to the first segment, emits aui-change if the value changed.
Closes without changing the value and returns focus to the button; does not reach a surrounding Dialog.
Closes without selecting and moves focus.
Moves through the segments, then the button.

focus: Each segment and the button are tab stops. Opening the listbox moves DOM focus to the listbox (tabindex=0); the active option is conveyed through aria-activedescendant, has a visible outline that does not rely on color alone, and is scrolled into view (centered on open). Selecting returns focus to the first segment; Escape and closing through the button return it to the button; focus is moved before the popup hides so it never falls to the document body.
notes: The label is a <label> associated through aria-labelledby because a group is not labelable; clicking the label focuses the first segment.
The required asterisk is aria-hidden; each segment carries the native required state.
Errors appear after the first blur of the whole control by default, so moving between segments does not trigger messages.
The button name is constant ("Choose time"); aria-expanded conveys the popup state.
knownCaveats: Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver, TalkBack) is pending.
Segment arrow navigation follows visual order and is not mirrored in RTL, unlike Date Input, because segments render as an LTR run.
